numeric_contract.input: Decimal strings preferred; exact integers accepted; JSON floats and non-finite values rejected
numeric_contract.output: Money, NAV, units, fees and ratios are decimal strings or null; IDs and versions are not money
numeric_contract.chart_numbers: Display conversions only; never used for financial settlement

order_fields.requested: BUY gross CNY or SELL units
order_fields.closed: Whether all remaining execution parts have ended
order_fields.bucket: BASE or TACTICAL, default BASE for legacy input; independent of channel FIFO allocations
order_fields.cash_source: EXTERNAL for new real transactions, TRACKED for demo/explicit cash ledger. Legacy events without field replay as TRACKED. EXTERNAL paid/refunded/settled amounts cross the tracked asset boundary; no wallet balance or cash reservation.
order_fields.submitted_at: Actual platform order time; independent of initial recorded_at. BEFORE_CUTOFF uses midnight only as ordering representation.
order_fields.recorded_at: Initial local registration timestamp; retained across edits.
order_fields.time_precision: EXACT/MINUTE/DAY or BEFORE_CUTOFF. BEFORE_CUTOFF displays a before15:00 window, never an invented clock.
order_fields.auto_confirm: Defaults enabled for supported real external fund orders; demo and tracked cash unchanged.
order_fields.automation: Derived progress, expected NAV/confirmation date and AUTO_OFFICIAL_NAV basis. Not a personal bank receipt.

time_contract.timestamps: ISO8601 with offset, normalized to UTC
time_contract.business_dates: YYYY-MM-DD; product/channel calendar; default business timezone Asia/Shanghai
time_contract.time_precision_DAY: CSV date-only facts use a midnight ordering representation and retain DAY precision; UI shows date without invented intraday time
time_contract.display_timezone: system preference or explicit user preference
time_contract.time_precision_MINUTE: Statement evidence only to minutes; stored seconds00 is a placeholder, displayed without seconds. Explicit ACTIVITY reference NAV date is a reconstruction assumption, not a confirmation.

transaction_contract: Write with a stable idempotency key; optimistic expected_revision for UI edits; event/cash/lot/audit replay in one SQLite transaction
reference_templates: input/templates; rules_checklist.csv is a human verification aid, not automatic rule activation

statement_contract.storage: versioned documents, separate from confirmed ledger events
statement_contract.closed_rows: omitted before persistence per user instruction
statement_contract.deduplication: fund, literal second, side, unit and normalized Decimal; overlapping references retained
statement_contract.unknown_confirmations: not posted to holdings or cash
statement_contract.timestamps: literal screenshot time, interpreted as Asia/Shanghai with explicit basis
statement_contract.pending_settlement: expected date is not actual cash receipt

public_nav.source: Eastmoney code/name-verified chart history plus current five-row disclosure API; THS fallback on primary failure
public_nav.parser: JSON literals only, never execute source JavaScript
public_nav.observed_at: actual first retrieval; historical publication times left unknown
public_nav.freshness: Cache-busting query and no-cache request headers per existing refresh. Always check bounded latest-NAV API even when a stale chart returns HTTP200. Validate prior-date identity anchors and choose current disclosure without rolling back a newer chart; supplementary failure preserves valid history and records its reason.
public_nav.evidence: Combined raw chart and latest JSON receipts under a stable content hash; corporate action fields retained, missing action field rejected. Unknown publication times remain null.

t_attribution.status: Legacy conditional pairing retained for traceability and migration; primary UI uses position_buckets
t_attribution.identity: residual_pnl + paired T net spread = total_pnl
t_attribution.fees: physical FIFO fees; economic pairing never reprices redemption fees
t_attribution.unpaired: null T result, not zero profit
t_attribution.persistence: versioned explicit pairs with statement and rule version guards; no ledger events

position_buckets.t_sell: Consume TACTICAL first, then BASE; entire net proceeds less all consumed costs attributed to TACTICAL
position_buckets.base_sell: Consume BASE only; reject insufficient available inventory
position_buckets.fees: Physical channel lot fees unchanged by economic bucket classification
position_buckets.identity: BASE total P&L + TACTICAL total P&L = fund total P&L
position_buckets.pending: Reserve units; actual confirmations consume units; cancellation releases remaining reservation
position_buckets.reference: Versioned screenshot classifications remain conditional NAV reconstruction, not confirmed ledger events
position_buckets.fund_card: Current selected fund shows its own BASE and TACTICAL market values and units; portfolio totals are labelled as totals; no frontend cost/valuation calculation

desktop.runtime: Swift AppKit WKWebView + frozen Python backend
desktop.resources: read-only app bundle; templates and frontend only
desktop.data: existing workspace, validated by stable workspace_id; no private data in bundle
desktop.service: loopback identity/version match; owned child exits with app, borrowed development service retained
desktop.signing: local ad-hoc; no Developer ID or notarization

tracking_opening.initial_split: User-specified current NAV value converted to fixed units; proportional remaining economic cost
tracking_opening.cash_scope: Historical redemptions excluded from available cash; only later recorded cash movements enter cash
tracking_opening.pnl: Preserve full historical P&L and realized T; new T float shown separately
tracking_opening.commit: POST /api/v1/funds/{id}/tracking/start; proposal token, revision and explicit acceptance

daily_t.snapshot: fund.daily_t includes reference market session, today quote, profile, derived preset options and input observation ids
daily_t.plan: daily_t_items is a separate non-executable reference; no order linking or ledger writes
daily_t.method: daily-t-2026-v2: 20 to 60 strictly prior absolute NAV returns, nearest-rank P80/P60/P40, ceil 0.1pp, minimum 0.5% or twice fee cap; single budget 2%/5%/8% of current marked holding, daily gross twice single budget
daily_t.fees: Physical FIFO; block if any consumed lot rate exceeds preset cap 0%/0.5%/0.5%; T may consume base per established attribution
daily_t.freshness: Same Shanghai date only; live estimate <=900 seconds. Verified 15:00 source close and SGE 15:30 day close or date-only SHAU PM fixing remain valid for that date. Current official NAV takes precedence; previous reference date and NAV must match. Closing display never bypasses the 15:00 order cutoff.
daily_t.calendar: 2026 verified CN/CN_HK/GOLD_CN reference sessions only; unknown market/year blocks. CN_HK for 012183 and 017954; CN for 021528,012738,019633. Fund subscription calendar remains distinct.
daily_t.cash: Reference gross amount only; never imply tracked cash equals channel balance

today_fields.display_title: 今日涨跌 or 收盘涨跌
today_fields.closing_label: 15:00 收盘估算 is source cutoff, not full HK session final or official NAV

daily_t.display: Header, sidebar and chart footer use fund.daily_t.today from backend; current date and source type visible. Never substitute yesterday NAV change for a missing live move. Official NAV wins; otherwise latest valid estimate, retained after close.

automatic_market_data.scope: Verified C classes: 008987, 012183, 012738, 017954, 019633, 021528; real account while app/backend runs
automatic_market_data.intraday: THS public literal minute protocol; Eastmoney JSONP fallback if available; never execute scripts; source website display switch off and endpoint undocumented
automatic_market_data.daily_nav: Eastmoney official-disclosure series; THS disclosed NAV fallback; missing corporate-action metadata pauses rules/research
automatic_market_data.cadence: Every 10 minutes during source sessions and after close until formal NAV. Keep checking formal NAV after 16:00 for same-day corrections. Explicit refresh bypasses interval. The current date official NAV has priority over estimates; keep closing estimate if no newer value is available.
automatic_market_data.failure: bounded HTTPS, 5 second timeout, byte cap, no redirects, automatic retry at least 600 seconds and at most 900 seconds; failed automatic fallback cooled for 6 hours; manual requests can retry immediately
automatic_market_data.provenance: source quote as_of distinct from observed_at/fetched_at; same minute/value deduplicated; first raw response hash retained; receipts cached under data/cache/providers
automatic_market_data.integrity: reference date and NAV must equal stored prior official NAV; stale/future/wrong-date/identity errors do not become usable quotes; estimates do not change ledger values or realized P&L
automatic_market_data.manual_refresh: explicit user refresh bypasses automatic interval, retry schedule and failed-fallback cooldown; active in-flight request is not duplicated; freshness/identity/source errors still apply

policy.protected: financial events, documents, official NAV, predictions, imports and referenced evidence

storage.pinning: Keep observations and raw receipt hashes referenced by financial events, settings, predictions, source imports, linked plans and their ancestors; keep last automatic quote per fund. Manual observations and all official NAV revisions remain.
storage.raw_capacity: 20 MiB target for unprotected hash-named provider files; protected evidence is exempt; no symlink traversal
storage.frontend_polling: 60-second cache reads while visible and idle; focus coalesces only when due; pause during pointer hold, scroll/resize/input and editing, resume after 1 second quiet; manual refresh/writes immediate; abort stale account requests, structurally share unchanged data
storage.compaction: Checkpoint WAL after cleanup; VACUUM only with at least 256 free pages and 20% free space; schema remains 3
storage.excluded: No automatic removal of input, output, backups, actual trades, official NAV or user preferences

asset_imports.source_handling: metadata only; original files remain outside the app import pipeline
asset_imports.money_encoding: decimal strings; missing = null; never infer shares from currency
asset_imports.closed_transactions: Codex removes invalid/closed rows before submission
asset_imports.duplicate_rows: normalized rows must be unique; the app does not clean them

gold_reference.fixed_fixing_time: date-only; as_of null; preserve actual first observed_at
gold_reference.scope: GOLD_CN day reference; not gram-gold accounting
gold_reference.closing: Verified current-date Au99.99 15:30 day-close point can remain visible until SHAU PM or formal NAV replaces it; preserve source clock and never use future/night placeholders.

sell_profit_preview.input: requested decimal units, bucket BASE|TACTICAL, optional occurred_at and physical allocations
sell_profit_preview.reference: fresh current quote when eligible, otherwise last official NAV; value kind/date/time/source retained
sell_profit_preview.profit: net receipts minus economic T-first cost; overflow base cost and all resulting sale P&L go to T
sell_profit_preview.fees: actual channel physical FIFO lots, per-lot money rounding, holding period as of requested date
sell_profit_preview.comparison: before/after at the same NAV; mark-to-reference effect separate from sell effect; realized profit is not added twice to total P&L
sell_profit_preview.unknown: unknown costs remain null; missing fee/availability/economic book blocks reliable preview
sell_profit_preview.persistence: no events, reservations, online fetches, or cached preview documents; recompute on input changes

display_summary.total_holdings: portfolio.return_valuation.market_value; confirmed units marked to eligible current quote or explicitly dated last official NAV
display_summary.total_pnl: portfolio.return_valuation.pnl; all realized BASE/TACTICAL P&L plus remaining holdings revalued at displayed basis
display_summary.font_roles: 16 text and captions; 20 titles; 28 primary values; no financial calculations in frontend

fund_sidebar.storage: versioned fund_sidebar/catalog document; included in backup; no schema change
fund_sidebar.editable: ordered named groups; fund display_name, group_id and observation theme
fund_sidebar.initial_groups: technology / healthcare / broad index / gold; PCB and AI are user observation themes
fund_sidebar.new_funds: unclassified after first custom save; never recreate deleted default groups
fund_sidebar.identity: canonical fund identity and financial ledger unchanged; removing a category unassigns its funds
fund_sidebar.folding: per-account local browser preferences; search temporarily reveals matches; selected fund category revealed

research_workbench.invocation: explicit POST /api/v1/research/runs, immutable same-snapshot comparison; GET and page navigation never generate analyses
research_workbench.data: six verified C funds: compact public NAV+action reconstructed total returns; 000198 daily income cash reference, last three calendar years; no wallet record
research_workbench.observations: month-end 252-session cash-excess trend, 20/60-observation returns, 60-return covariance risk, 252-observation drawdown; current registered fund scope
research_workbench.targets: explicit user targets and research level; reuse frozen generators/risk constraints, preserve BASE floors, no execution amounts when only reference calendar/unknown research budget
research_workbench.full_engine: validated same-identity/units/NAV full research snapshot plus user-configured targets/risk and explicit independent budget; fees, lots, dealing calendar and time integrity remain required
research_workbench.real_defaults: OBSERVE; unknown cash budget stays null; synthetic policy never copied into real mode
research_workbench.value: minimum 60 months consistent bottom-index valuations; no NAV-to-valuation substitution; current missing series remain WAIT
research_workbench.retention: latest compact research series, latest policy/input, latest 30 compressed runs with complete reproducible context; saved forecasts/resolutions remain permanent
research_workbench.forecast_tracking: explicit study creation records idempotent LAST_VALUE benchmarks per fund/NAV/target-date; later official NAV resolves once; backend Decimal MAE/MAPE
research_workbench.independence: no financial events, actual holdings, bucket attribution, actual orders, or T-profile writes; execution_enabled false
research_workbench.recommendation_reads: GET /api/v1/recommendations/current computes read-only references; explicit legacy POST remains available
research_workbench.reference_calendar: research-only SSE 2025/2026; never substituted for product dealing-calendar proof

midday_quote.equity_estimate_source: CN reference-session BREAK, including CN_HK products; preserve same-day verified morning estimates and original time
midday_quote.freshness: extended only during lunch; strict live freshness resumes at 13:00, never carry yesterday or unknown-source quotes
midday_quote.collection: fill missing morning quote during lunch; cached complete morning skips automatic polling, manual unrestricted
midday_quote.t_reference: paused while source rests; gold day session independent

order_automation.process: POST /orders/process; exact disclosed NAV and normal T+1 local assumption, no external orders
order_automation.edit: POST /orders/{id}/edit; stable order ID, key, expected_revision or expected_order_updated_at; atomic reversal/replacement and automatic recalculation
order_automation.sources: See docs/development/AUTO_BOOKKEEPING.md; reference calendar is not promoted to a verified product dealing calendar.
order_automation.cash_settlement: Automatic calculation does not assert a bank receipt. Optional actual settlement remains distinct.

day_valuation.definition: Current confirmed units * (eligible current-day reference NAV - previous trading-day official NAV); a price-impact reference, not cash-flow-adjusted actual daily income.
day_valuation.fund: price_change/base_change/tactical_change/holding_value decimal strings or null; T cents = total - BASE; source and date retained.
day_valuation.portfolio: total only for complete holding coverage; known_subtotal for partial coverage; NOT_OPEN and unknown are null, never zero.
day_valuation.writes: Read-only snapshot projection; never changes formal P&L or ledger.

manual_refresh_all.result: Independent COMPLETED/WAIT/FAILED/UNSUPPORTED outcomes and counts; no application lock over network; automatic ten-minute cadence unchanged.

forecasting.task: TOTAL_RETURN; 1/5 reference session horizons; NAV projection conditional on no distributions/splits
forecasting.evaluation: Fixed rolling prefixes; separate validation/calibration/final tests; model selected only on validation with 2% MAE improvement threshold. Public historical reconstruction, not point-in-time trading evidence.
forecasting.errors: Model ratios; resolution *_pp fields are percentage points. Scores partition by engine/fund/horizon; no mixing with old NAV errors.
forecasting.storage: forecast_run maximum 10 compressed analyses, compact immutable forecast_prediction/forecast_resolution permanent; no ledger writes
forecasting.automatic: After first successful generation, App checks at least 10 minutes apart; new formal basis generates next forecasts, formal NAV plus verified research TR resolves outcomes; GET never fits or writes
forecasting.scope: Six independently verified C-class funds; demo never borrows real history; no direct trading or new wallet constraints.

investment_plan.profile: Per-fund enabled, holding_cap, versioned DAILY_LADDER_V1 or DRAWDOWN_GUARD_V2 template and optimistic version; V2 explicitly enabled only for 021528
investment_plan.reference: Enabled profile replaces this fund daily_t_items reference, level PLAN; profile_version is investment_plan_profile version. GET is read-only and does not create forecasts or trade records.
investment_plan.budget: User-defined fund marked-holding cap, not wallet cash. Current marked units plus all unconfirmed active buy requests consume cap. Pending sells release no capacity before confirmation.
investment_plan.ladder: Absolute daily change 1%/2%/3% sets cumulative directional target at holding_cap*5%/10%/15%; below1% HOLD. Subtract effective same-day T orders. Total daily two-way cap15%; do not reverse direction intraday.
investment_plan.sale: Only available T units, constrained by physical available FIFO fee-free prefix. Net expected realized profit must meet max(CNY2, gross*0.5%). Same-price sell impact reused; no forced base sale or resetting base.
investment_plan.time: Original quote eligibility and Beijing date/cutoff. Valid lunch/close quote may show preview-only scenario, can_apply false. Preopen, stale and missing quote have no executable amount.
investment_plan.execution: Reference only. Record-already-operated opens a prefilled form and never submits or executes externally. Manual T fallback policy is unchanged.
investment_plan.storage: Current small profile and up to20 user-saved history entries per fund, no per-refresh storage growth.
investment_plan.efficacy: Fixed execution discipline, not fitted to maximize profit and no demonstrated repeatable excess return; forecast experimental estimates do not change tiers.

drawdown_guard_v2.scope: Multiday risk discipline; not a proven-return forecast or automatic trade
drawdown_guard_v2.volatility: Prior disclosed official returns, max 60, nearest-rank absolute-return percentile 60, at least 20 returns, minimum 1%, ceil to 0.1 percentage point
drawdown_guard_v2.risk_states: NORMAL / DEFENSIVE / PAUSED, separate formal close recovery; current estimate may tighten only
drawdown_guard_v2.capital: max(marked holding, remaining BASE + T economic cost) + active buy remainder; no wallet cash requirement
drawdown_guard_v2.limits: Daily cumulative 5/10/15% cap targets at h/2h/3h; defensive BUY half; rolling five reference-session buy cap 15% or 7.5%; one or two full intervening reference sessions between buying dates
drawdown_guard_v2.sales: Risk buy pause does not block an otherwise qualifying T-only FIFO fee-free profitable sale
drawdown_guard_v2.storage: Derived read-only from official history and effective order projection; no per-refresh persistence

sell_buy_comparison.selection: Latest remaining confirmed T buy, otherwise latest remaining confirmed BASE buy; manual same-fund selection is comparison only
sell_buy_comparison.reference: min(sale units, unreserved remaining purchase units); cost from current economic positions including purchase fee; rounded sale gross and fee allocated by compared units / total sale units
sell_buy_comparison.outputs: buy_comparison net_price_edge / gross_price_edge / fee_share / covered_units / uncovered_units / remaining_holding_pnl / available_units; actual expected_realized_pnl and cumulative P&L unchanged
sell_buy_comparison.guard: No invented unconfirmed, fully sold, future or unknown-cost purchase; new shares may be unavailable despite positive comparison; comparisons never post or get added to total P&L
sell_buy_comparison.ui: Separate price comparison and original-cost realized P&L, prominent BASE fallback; plan-enabled new orders default T only when no explicit bucket or draft; existing purchase can be edited explicitly

return_valuation.fund: Read-only compact BucketBook summary at the eligible daily_t.today quote; current official NAV first, otherwise valid live/lunch/closing estimate, otherwise explicitly labelled last official NAV.
return_valuation.portfolio: Original formal equity and pnl plus sum of fund current holding-value minus formal holding-value, once only. Pending purchases, sales, cash and cost unchanged. Mixed basis explicitly reports last_official_count.
return_valuation.display: Income panel, current BASE/T holdings, top holdings/total P&L and overview share this projection. Realized P&L changes only with confirmed events. Classification drafts keep their independent preview basis.
return_valuation.daily: day_valuation is a separate current-units price-impact reference, not cash-flow-adjusted daily earnings. Never add it again to already revalued cumulative P&L.
return_valuation.writes: No financial event, reservation, setting, prediction, quote or cached snapshot writes. Existing portfolio.pnl/market_value/equity and position_buckets retain formal semantics.
return_valuation.freshness: Reuse daily_t eligibility; no added network polling or history storage. NOT_OPEN/stale/missing today values are not displayed as zero daily profit.

holding_composition.scope: Read-only per-fund current marked holdings; same summary as return_valuation; no ledger or preference writes.
holding_composition.fields: total value/units/cost/unrealized/realized/pnl/holding_return; BASE and TACTICAL groups with weight/pnl_weight/pnl_direction; unknown monetary values remain null.
holding_composition.weights: Current group market value over total marked holdings. BASE rounded to 12 decimal places; TACTICAL is the residual so both sum to one. Empty or unknown holdings have null weights.
holding_composition.profit: pnl_weight is absolute group cumulative P&L over sum of both absolute P&Ls; explicit sign and negative hatch retained. Zero net return with opposing P&L is valid; zero magnitude and unknown costs do not fabricate a chart.
holding_composition.return: holding_return = current unrealized P&L / remaining cost, only for known positive cost; never divide historical realized P&L by a tiny remaining position.
holding_composition.display: One total, exact BASE/T donut, amount/units/weights and floating/cumulative P&L rows, absolute P&L composition bar. Frontend only formats and maps ratios to geometry; 16/20/28px, black text, khaki BASE and blue T.

daily_agenda.source: One current snapshot and existing daily_t_references; no alternate rule or amount engine.
daily_agenda.groups: actions,needs_input,waiting,funds; normal expected confirmation is waiting, not an error.
daily_agenda.guard: Only can_apply references from matching current inputs; return exact requested amount/units and expiry. Cross-GET snapshot_basis must match before frontend exposes an operation. Lunch/close/expired/partial calendars are read-only.
daily_agenda.writes: Read-only; no network, fitting, financial events or per-refresh documents. Recording opens a prefilled form and never submits externally.

holding_reconciliation.scope: User supplied channel snapshot, confirmed units excluding pending; old/historical screenshots are evidence only. Current unit comparison requires a same-Beijing-day snapshot within10minutes with no later relevant financial changes.
holding_reconciliation.amounts: Same formal NAV date; holding P&L also requires same remaining-cost basis. Unverified fee amounts are evidence only.
holding_reconciliation.writes: Explicit token-bound snapshot save only; 5 latest per fund. No holdings/financial events or balance adjustments. Later fund-specific changes mark old comparisons stale.

t_review.exit_reference: Sum of separate confirmed T exit references: redemption net minus same sold units held at the selected current quote. May overlap repeated cycles and is not a whole-fund alpha.
t_review.scenario: Explicit VIRTUAL_RETAINED_PROCEEDS hypothetical comparison with same starting units, virtual cash0, and matched extra external contributions; not a wallet balance. Pending transactions defer the baseline and freeze once after all existing/new pending flows complete.
t_review.proceeds: Confirmed proceeds are receivable; only recorded settlement makes them virtually reusable. Buy contributions and fee/unit rounding use the actual acquired shares.
t_review.guard: Corrections to baseline prefix invalidate the comparison; unsupported flows give partial/null rather than invented precise gain.
t_review.storage: One versioned baseline per fund and latest5 previous summaries; no financial events or recurring comparison snapshots.

local_maintenance.backup: Meaningful ledger/user-document change triggers at most1 Beijing-daily automatic snapshot while running. Retain7 daily copies; manual/update/restore backups preserved. Quote-only traffic does not trigger daily copies.
local_maintenance.update: Installer verifies workspace/bundle, snapshots data and archives the prior app before atomic replacement. Startup failure can revert only if ledger/schema unchanged; live authorization wait is preserved.
local_maintenance.signing: Optional existing Keychain identity SHA1, otherwise explicit local ad-hoc. No certificate creation, TCC changes, or promise to remove macOS permissions.
local_maintenance.preferences: Restore the last page, mode, selected fund and overview/detail locally; explicit fund URL opens workspace.

valuation_explanation.source: Existing same-quote holding_composition and return_valuation plus original events; one read transaction.
valuation_explanation.equation: Fund cumulative P&L = holding market value minus remaining cost plus realized. Portfolio separates other tracked items. Estimates never post to ledger.
valuation_explanation.fees: Purchase fee is in cost and sale fee in net redemption. Fees already embedded in NAV are not deducted twice. Event history shows causes but is not an invented money-flow-adjusted daily attribution.
valuation_explanation.close_accuracy: Collector freezes close evidence saved before the first saved verified formal value; use an earlier actual publication time when supplied, never invent it. First formal outcome retained, revisions separate. Same prior NAV required for percentage-point errors. Later quotes cannot be backfilled as earlier estimates.
valuation_explanation.storage: At most30 compact close_estimate_result receipts per fund, independently durable beyond7day minute-cache. Repeated collection deduplicates; read requests never record results.

portfolio_risk.scope: Only registered fund holdings and user-edited categories, not personal total assets or look-through holdings. Unknown valuations have known subtotal only; no fake zero/weight.
portfolio_risk.correlation: At least20, at most60 matched start-and-end return intervals from verified total returns or corporate-action-complete formal NAV with no unhandled actions. No forward filling or forecast interpretation.
portfolio_risk.operations: Sum only currently executable existing daily plan references; lunch/closed/expired omitted. Expiry and snapshot_basis checked by UI. No wallet constraint, trades, fitting or snapshots.

plan_scenarios.request: expected_version=current investment-plan version; expected_nav_id=current formal NAV id. Read-only bounded compute, no persistence or network.
plan_scenarios.paths: Three fixed8period scenarios, scaled by initial h. Production investment_plan_reference/investment_risk/schedule/fee/FIFO/BucketBook reused.
plan_scenarios.dealing: Hypothetical application-period NAV, actual modeled T+1 confirmation and conservative T+2 sellability per current product calendar. Unverified dates do not trade.
plan_scenarios.scope: Current confirmed holdings and same plan. Existing pending orders remain reserved, not guessed. Partial coverage leaves complete terminal assets/P&L null. Hypothetical extra contributions are not actual wallet money. Disabled plans not auto-enabled.

forecast_scorecard.scope: Original frozen forecast plus first formal resolution, grouped by engine/fund/1or5reference-day horizon. Duplicate opportunity revisions never double count or select the favorable result.
forecast_scorecard.metrics: Counts, MAE and zero-return baseline MAE in percentage points, recent20 resolved results. Retrospective final-test results separate. Zero prediction abstains from direction and actual flat days are excluded with explicit denominator.
forecast_scorecard.unknown: Unresolved results null, never0. Six verified experimental funds only; seventh reports not in experiment. GET does not fit, resolve or write.
